candidates.title: Grandfather's name carved atop the Great Pyramid
candidates.quote: from the top we found the name p initial P Hancock 5th of April 1916.

link.reason: Hancock finding his grandfather Philip Hancock's 1916 name carved on top of the Great Pyramid. The Great Pyramid stories below are theories about what the pyramid was for, not this family discovery.

candidates.title: Younger Dryas impact from the Taurid meteor stream
candidates.quote: this hypothesis known as the younger driest impact Theory sustains that an asteroid from the torrid meteor stream hit the earth causing a global cataclysm

link.reason: Both tell the theory that the Younger Dryas cataclysm was caused by an impact from the Taurid meteor stream, and Michels tells it in the story already, crediting Hancock.
link.difference: Calls the impactor an asteroid rather than a comet airburst, does not name Napier, and adds a date of c. 12,800 years ago.

candidates.title: Gobekli Tepe megalithic site
candidates.quote: older take quebecally Tepe an ancient burial site in modern turkey dating as far back as 9000 BC and involving the complex assembly of 50 ton blocks

link.reason: Both present Göbekli Tepe in Turkey as so old that it pushes back the age of human civilization.
link.difference: Adds a date of 9000 BC and the 50-ton blocks.

candidates.title: Michael Shermer's wedding-night clock
candidates.quote: about Michael Shermer there's a story about him and I think his wife Jennifer and they were I was like on their wedding night uh this mechanical clock starts playing in the other room that was an heirloom from her father

link.reason: The same Shermer wedding story: an heirloom from Jennifer's family plays music unexpectedly in another room.
link.difference: Told secondhand. Says it was a mechanical clock on the wedding night, where Shermer says it was a radio in a desk on the wedding day.

candidates.title: Shoemaker-Levy 9 hits Jupiter
candidates.quote: Shoemaker Levy 9 which collided with Jupiter in 1994.

link.reason: The same 1994 impact of Comet Shoemaker-Levy 9 on Jupiter.
link.difference: Does not mention the 21 fragments or the July date.

candidates.title: Tunguska airburst as part of the Taurid stream

link.reason: The same claim that the 30 June 1908 Tunguska airburst was part of the Taurid stream, with the same wording.
link.difference: Credited to Hancock rather than Carlson.

candidates.title: NASA DART asteroid deflection mission
candidates.quote: DART program aimed to prove that humans can deflect asteroids with satellites and prevent Earth impact

link.reason: The same NASA DART mission that struck Dimorphos to test asteroid deflection.
link.difference: Frames it as proving that humans can deflect asteroids and spans 2021-2022.

candidates.title: Next 30 years a danger time in the Taurid stream

link.reason: A claim that the next 30 years are a danger time in the Taurid stream. The Taurid stories below are about past impacts and where the stream came from, not this forecast.

candidates.title: Crick's directed panspermia: seeded spaceship hits early Earth
candidates.quote: one of those spaceships collided with the early Earth Spilled Out its contents of bacteria

link.reason: Both are about Francis Crick's directed panspermia proposal, which this telling dates 1973/1981 and ties to the paper and to his book.
link.difference: Adds the image of a seeded spaceship hitting early Earth 3.9 billion years ago and credits Crick's book Life Itself (1981), not only the 1973 paper.

candidates.title: Food of the Gods psychedelic origin of consciousness
candidates.quote: anybody who's listening his book food of the Gods yeah was one of the first books

link.reason: Both tell McKenna's theory that human consciousness came from psychedelic mushrooms, which is the stone ape theory set out in Food of the Gods.
